d: After a gymnastics accident leaves him severely brain-damaged, Blake Hyland creates a platform to bring awareness and hope to everyone he meets on the road to recovery while his family wrestles to restore him to his former self.
On Pine Ridge Reservation, Lakota teens find hope racing horses in Indian Relay.
Explore the healing power of drumming through community leaders using the universal language of rhythm.
An ode to an everyday hero: Bill Marsh, a swim teacher who helps children manage their fears.
Neurofibromatosis affects individuals with a genetic disease that causes tumors. These are their stories.
The sweet and sassy residents of a retirement community explain the many upsides of getting older.

For over a decade, Barbie Carter was among the thousands on individuals living on Skid Row, Los Angeles. After being approved for housing, she forges a bond with an aid worker, and together they work to keep her off the streets.
When faced with certain death by ALS, photographer-turned-local legend Arthur Cohen decides to leave a legacy of pickles -- PickALS, that is.
A documentary detailing how a backyard game from 1965 became a bold movement uniting generations. Exploring the people, passion and communities behind America's fastest growing sport.
Angela Madsen, a Paralympian and Marine veteran, set out to be the first paraplegic and oldest woman to row the Pacific Ocean alone.
